meaning.zh:
“两全其美”。

这个短语的意思是，从两种不同的情况或选择中获得最大的好处而没有任何负面影响。它最早可以追溯到19世纪，强调一种理想的、完美的状态，其中两种相对的事物能够和谐共存。
meaning.en: This phrase means to get the greatest benefits from two different situations or choices without any negative consequences. It can be traced back to the 19th century and emphasizes an ideal, perfect state in which two contrasting things coexist harmoniously.

lines.en: Working from home gives me *the best of both worlds*; I can be productive and spend more time with my family.
lines.zh: 在家工作让我两全其美；我既能高效工作，又能花更多时间陪伴家人。

lines.en: This hybrid car offers *the best of both worlds* by being both eco-friendly and cost-effective.
lines.zh: 这款混合动力车两全其美，既环保又经济实惠。

lines.en: With this job, you get *the best of both worlds*: a good salary and flexible hours.
lines.zh: 有了这份工作，你可以两全其美：既有高薪水，又有灵活的工作时间。
